objective: Produce deterministic isolated rehearsal and rollback evidence for the exact approved epoch-002 event-sourced ontology product, then present one final admission decision without activating or cutting over the runtime.
invariants: The approved manifest identity is immutable throughout rehearsal.
Canonical events are the only replay source; projections and snapshots never become replay sources.
Every node and relation state is calculated from its canonical event stream.
Each node and relation may expose a latest snapshot only as a disposable projection accelerator.
Governance and Ontology Lifecycle context bindings use the exact approved v2 Context Map.
Challenge contracts remain explicit ontology records and their relationships survive replay.
Rehearsal uses isolated local fixtures and disposable state only.
The admitted epoch-001 runtime and every protected byte named by the epoch-002 manifest remain unchanged.
Rollback restores every tracked preimage digest before rehearsal evidence may pass.
Wrong context, reverse relation, partial stream, snapshot-source escalation, missing challenge contract, and authority escalation must be detected.
Passing rehearsal evidence grants no admission, activation, migration, cutover, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
The only owner gate occurs after all rehearsal and rollback evidence is frozen.

stages.objective: Bind the exact approved product and prove its decision and evidence hashes are current.
done_when: Product approval validation is PASS and all four approved-product paths match their bound SHA-256 values.

stages.objective: Author the isolation, event-source, projection, context, challenge-contract, and rollback contract.
done_when: The contract denies external effects, names every protected byte, and defines canonical-event and noncanonical-snapshot rules.

stages.objective: Build a deterministic local harness and fixtures without modifying the approved candidate or admitted runtime.
done_when: The runner executes only against copied or temporary state and records preimages before any rehearsal write.

stages.objective: Run replay twice and prove byte-identical node, relation, context, and challenge-contract projections.
done_when: Both deterministic runs agree and every declared hostile mutation is detected.

stages.objective: Prove exact rollback and protected-byte preservation after rehearsal.
done_when: Every tracked post-rollback SHA-256 equals its preimage and no external state was touched.

stages.objective: Freeze one admission candidate binding the approved product, rehearsal evidence, rollback receipt, and claim ceiling.
done_when: Candidate hashes are current, independent validation passes, and activation/cutover remain false.

stages.objective: Resolve the single final admission decision for the exact rehearsed product.
outputs: owner decision or explicit defer/reject/amend outcome
done_when: One option is selected against one immutable candidate digest; no cutover is inferred.

rehearsal_scope.calculated_state: latest node and relation state obtained only by folding canonical events
forbidden_effects: activate a runtime or Context Map

required_checks: canonical event order and identity stable
validation_contract.pass_rule: All checks and all hostile mutations pass twice with zero protected-byte drift and zero external effects.
validation_contract.failure_rule: Freeze the failed evidence, mark dependent stages not_evaluable, and do not open the final gate.

options.meaning: Admit the exact approved and rehearsed product without activation, migration, or cutover.
Reject the exact admission candidate and preserve all evidence.
Defer without changing product or runtime state.
Require amendment and a new complete rehearsal evidence set.

operational_tasks.detail: Repair unrelated source-digest, Craft, inherited-contract, and ontology-view drift. This does not block isolated rehearsal because none is a selected rehearsal dependency.
Integrate the existing dirty D65 work with an exact allowlist after product work; it does not change rehearsal semantics.
The final admission decision becomes evaluable only after RH-S5 freezes complete rehearsal and rollback evidence.

claim_ceiling: A validated planning candidate for isolated local rehearsal and a later exact admission decision. It does not execute rehearsal, admit or activate the product, migrate or cut over data, publish, release, deploy, use credentials, perform destructive action, or create external effects.
